_note: English descriptions for composite and direct source columns that feed DBN nodes. Used in the SLM NER prompt (Level 2 routing) so the model can match user text to a source column when no specific item column match exists. Keys are source_column names as they appear in feature_node_config.json source_column_bins and column_question_map.csv composite_column field.
phq_total: PHQ-9 total score — overall severity of depressive symptoms over the past two weeks (0-27). Covers low mood, loss of interest, sleep problems, fatigue, appetite changes, self-worth, concentration, psychomotor changes, and thoughts of death.
pss_helplessness: Perceived Stress Scale helplessness subscale — how often the person felt unable to control important things in their life or felt difficulties were piling up uncontrollably (past month).
pss_self_efficacy: Perceived Stress Scale self-efficacy subscale — how often the person felt confident handling personal problems and felt things were going their way (past month).
panas_pa: Positive Affect total — composite of enthusiasm, inspiration, and other positive emotional states. Higher = more positive emotional tone.
panas_na: Negative Affect total — composite of hostility, guilt, fear, and distress. Higher = more negative emotional tone.
lonely_total: UCLA Loneliness Scale total — overall sense of social isolation, lack of companionship, and feeling left out or excluded.
vr_physical_health: SF-36 Physical Health composite — overall physical functioning including activity limitations, pain interference, and self-rated general health.
vr_mental_health: SF-36 Mental Health composite — overall mental and emotional functioning including energy levels, emotional role limitations, and social activity interference.
sleep_disturbances: Sleep disturbance composite — frequency of disrupted sleep events including waking in the night, difficulty falling asleep, bad dreams, pain during sleep, coughing or snoring, and low daytime enthusiasm.
diabetes_status: Diabetes status composite — whether a doctor has ever diagnosed diabetes, prediabetes, or current insulin use.
chronic_condition: Chronic condition composite — whether a doctor has ever diagnosed any of: arthritis, gout, coronary heart disease, heart attack, thyroid problem, COPD, abdominal pain disorder, or obesity.
pain_level: Chest pain and exertional discomfort composite — presence of chest pain or shortness of breath on stairs or inclines, indicating cardiovascular or respiratory strain.
extraversion: Big Five extraversion trait score — how talkative, outgoing, sociable, and energetic the person is versus reserved and quiet.
neuroticism: Big Five neuroticism trait score — tendency toward negative emotions including depression, anxiety, moodiness, tension, and nervousness.
